zh.summary: 以 Given／When／Then 把工作承諾寫成可觀察的情境，補上缺漏、空白與輸入變更等負向案例。
objectives: 區分前置條件、觸發動作與可觀察結果。
為完整性檢核寫出正常與負向驗收情境。
說明驗收情境與可執行測試之間仍需要哪些連結。

sections.heading: 如何確認軟體真的符合需求？
paragraphs: 這堂課屬於「規格驅動軟體開發」（Specification-Driven Development）。它要解決一個軟體開發中很常見的問題：
我們明明告訴工程師或 AI 要做什麼，為什麼做出來的系統，卻不一定是我們真正想要的？
原因之一，是我們常常只描述「要有哪些功能」，卻沒有清楚定義「怎樣才算正確，以及什麼情況下必須拒絕」。
這堂課的核心，就是學會把模糊的需求，轉成任何工程師、AI Coding Agent 或測試人員都能共同理解、實際執行的驗收條件。

sections.heading: 一、先理解 Given／When／Then 到底是什麼
paragraphs: 想像你去餐廳點餐。
你告訴服務生：「我要一份牛排，不要洋蔥。」
餐點送來後，你發現牛排有洋蔥。服務生說：「可是牛排確實做出來了。」
這時候，問題不在於餐廳有沒有完成「製作牛排」這個功能，而在於餐廳沒有遵守你真正提出的條件。
軟體開發也是如此。
我們不能只說「做一個訂餐系統」，還必須說清楚，當使用者做出某種操作時，系統在特定條件下應該產生什麼結果。
這就是 Given／When／Then 的用途。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜Given／When／Then 的三個時間位置
blocks.description: 箭頭表示同一情境由前置條件、觸發動作走向預期結果；這是訂餐的合成示例。

items.title: Given — 假設／前置條件｜開始前
items.body: 顧客已選擇牛排，但尚未填寫外送地址。

items.title: When — 當／觸發動作｜操作時
items.body: 顧客按下「確認訂單」。

items.title: Then — 那麼／預期結果｜操作後
items.body: 系統提示「請填寫外送地址」，不得建立正式訂單，且保留已選餐點。

paragraphs: 這三個關鍵字其實就是在問三件事：

blocks.caption: 三段各自回答的問題
rows: 系統開始時具備哪些條件？
怎樣才算成功或正確拒絕？

paragraphs: 這種描述方式常用於 BDD（Behavior-Driven Development，行為驅動開發）。其中 Gherkin 是用來描述這些行為情境的結構化語法；Cucumber 則是能把情境連結到自動化測試程式的工具之一。

sections.heading: 二、為什麼不能只寫「系統要正常運作」？
paragraphs: 假設你請 AI 做一個銀行匯款系統。
你提出的需求是：
「讓客戶可以轉帳，系統要安全。」
這樣的要求看似合理，但不夠明確。
如果 AI 做出一個按下轉帳就顯示「成功」的畫面，究竟算不算完成？沒有真的扣款呢？扣款兩次呢？餘額不足還是允許轉帳呢？
因此，我們需要把需求變成可判斷的規則。
以一個簡化的示範匯款系統為例：

blocks.heading: 規格片段
paragraphs: 這段文字定義預期行為，尚未連到測試執行。
blocks.code:
Scenario: 餘額不足時不得轉帳

Given 我的帳戶有 1,000 元
When 我要求轉帳 1,500 元
Then 系統應拒絕這筆轉帳
And 顯示「餘額不足」
And 我的帳戶餘額仍為 1,000 元
And 收款人帳戶不得增加 1,500 元

paragraphs: 這裡又多了 `And`，意思是「而且」，可以補充其他必須同時成立的條件。
你會發現，一個簡單的轉帳要求，至少包含四個驗收重點：拒絕交易、顯示原因、不得扣款、不得入帳。
好的驗收情境，不只是說系統應該做什麼，也要明確說出不應該發生什麼。

sections.heading: 三、正向驗收與負向驗收的差別
paragraphs: 正向驗收（Positive Acceptance）就是檢查：條件都正確的時候，系統能不能完成工作。
負向驗收（Negative Acceptance）則是檢查：條件不正確、資料有問題或權限不足的時候，系統能不能安全地拒絕、阻止或處理異常。

blocks.caption: 六種產業的正向與負向驗收
rows: 庫存不足時不得承諾出貨
餘額足夠時完成合法轉帳
餘額不足時不得扣款或入帳
合格人員可讀取授權病歷
未授權人員不得取得病歷內容
員工可查看自己的薪資單
不得查看其他員工的薪資
達到修課條件可完成選課
未修完先修課程不得選入限制課程
超出工具權限時不得執行受保護操作

paragraphs: 負向驗收並不是故意讓系統失敗，而是在確認系統遇到不正確情況時，仍然遵守規則。

blocks.heading: 顯示錯誤與實際阻止錯誤
paragraphs: 以伺服器回應與實際取得的內容核對授權。
假設某醫療系統不允許一般行政人員下載完整病歷。
當行政人員按下下載時，系統畫面顯示：
「您沒有權限。」
但如果檔案已經透過 API 回傳，只是前端沒有顯示下載按鈕，這樣仍然是不安全的。
因為我們真正需要驗證的是：

- 使用者沒有取得檔案內容。
- 伺服器確實拒絕了未授權的要求。
- 不得透過其他介面繞過授權檢查。
所以，負向驗收要同時觀察兩個層面：使用者看到的結果，以及受保護的動作是否真的被阻止。

sections.heading: 四、教材的四大驗收情境
paragraphs: 以下沿用本課的合成收件檢核案例。
教材採用一個合成的收件檢核系統，假設表單有三個必要欄位：申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。
它設計四個不同情境。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜四個平行的驗收情境
blocks.description: A–D 各自驗證不同條件，沒有先後順序；D 內部的資料變更使舊檢核結果失效。

items.title: 情境 A：完整資料
items.body: 三個欄位都有有效內容，使用者按下檢查。系統應通過完整性檢核，允許預覽與匯出同一筆資料的報告。

items.title: 情境 B：缺少必要欄位
items.body: 文件類型沒有填寫。系統必須指出缺漏，禁止匯出標記為完整的報告，同時保留使用者已填的資料。

items.title: 情境 C：輸入只有空白字元
items.body: 申請人代號輸入了三個空格。雖然文字欄位不一定是空字串，但清除前後空白後沒有有效內容，仍應視為缺漏。

items.title: 情境 D：先前通過，但資料後來改變
items.body: 使用者先通過檢查，之後卻刪除了文件類型。原本通過的結果應立即失效，不得直接使用舊的成功狀態匯出。

paragraphs: 情境 D 要確認檢核結果仍對應目前的資料版本。
假設一筆銀行徵信資料，上午 10 點經過檢核，符合所有條件；上午 10 點 5 分有人修改了重要欄位；10 點 10 分另一個人準備匯出報告。
如果系統仍然沿用 10 點的檢核結果，這個結果可能已經不適用。
因此，系統應有機制讓檢核結果與被檢核的資料版本相對應，在匯出時重新確認其有效性。
這也涉及軟體安全中常見的 TOCTOU（Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use，檢查與使用之間的時間差）問題。它的核心是：某件事情在檢查時成立，不代表在真正使用時仍然成立。

sections.heading: 五、如何把驗收情境交給 AI Coding Agent？
paragraphs: 這個概念和 AI 協作開發非常有關係。
不好的指令可能是：
> 幫我做一個資料檢查功能，讓使用者可以匯出報告。
這種指令讓 AI 有很大的自行解釋空間。
比較好的做法，是先把需求與驗收情境寫進 `spec.md`。
以下是簡化的文件範例：

blocks.heading: 規格片段
paragraphs: 這段文字定義預期行為，尚未連到測試執行。
blocks.code:
# 收件完整性檢核規格

## 業務規則
三個必要欄位都必須有非空白值，
才能將報告標記為完整並匯出。

## Scenario A：資料完整
Given 三個必要欄位皆有有效值
When 使用者要求檢查並匯出
Then 顯示完整性通過
And 允許匯出目前資料的報告

## Scenario B：資料缺漏
Given 文件類型為空
When 使用者要求匯出
Then 顯示文件類型缺漏
And 不得匯出完整報告
And 保留其他已填資料

## Scenario C：空白輸入
Given 申請人代號僅含空白字元
When 使用者按下檢查
Then 將此欄位視為缺漏
And 不得標記完整

## Scenario D：檢核結果過期
Given 先前的資料已通過檢核
And 使用者後來清空文件類型
When 使用者要求匯出
Then 原先的檢核結果不得繼續使用
And 必須檢查目前的資料
And 不得匯出完整報告

paragraphs: 接著可以要求 AI：
「請依據 `spec.md` 實作這個功能，為四個情境建立相對應的測試。不要自行放寬必要欄位的規則，完成後提供實際測試結果與程式碼差異。」
這時 `spec.md` 就像工程師與 AI 共同遵守的契約。
不過要注意，寫出 Gherkin 或 Markdown 情境，不代表測試已經自動執行。如果要使用 Cucumber 自動測試，還需要 Step Definitions（步驟定義），把自然語言連接到實際測試程式。也可以用 pytest、介面測試等方式實作相同的驗收要求。

blocks.heading: 規格變更也要更新情境
paragraphs: 若新增第四個必要欄位，請同步更新規格、正常與缺漏情境、表單及測試資料，並由領域負責人確認新規則。

sections.heading: 六、如何判斷驗收條件寫得好不好？
paragraphs: 用下面這個判斷表即可。

blocks.caption: 六項驗收品質檢查
rows: 回傳拒絕結果，且不建立訂單
記錄測試名稱、執行結果與版本

paragraphs: 證據欄位讓他人可以查核實際執行。
即使你寫了十條驗收情境，也只能證明你定義了應該如何驗收，不能證明系統已經通過驗收。
實務上，應建立：

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜需求到可查核證據的追溯鏈
blocks.description: 箭頭表示相鄰層次需要有可查核的連結；畫出這條鏈不代表測試已執行或已通過。

items.title: 需求（Requirement）
items.body: 定義工作承諾與禁止結果。

items.title: 驗收情境（Acceptance Scenario）
items.body: 以具體條件、動作與結果表達需求。

items.title: 測試案例（Test Case）
items.body: 指定如何操作與比較實際結果。

items.title: 執行結果（Test Result）
items.body: 記錄本次實際觀察到的結果。

items.title: 可查核證據（Evidence）
items.body: 保存測試版本、命令與結果，供他人重查。

paragraphs: 例如，規格要求不得匯出不完整報告，對應的測試就必須實際嘗試匯出，並確認沒有產生或交付被標記為完整的報告。證據應記錄測試的版本、命令與結果，而非只有 AI 說「測試通過」。
這就是從「我們希望系統正確」走向「我們有證據支持系統符合要求」。

blocks.heading: 維持可觀察且與外觀分離的條件
paragraphs: 以實際拒絕與允許的動作判斷，不以按鈕位置、顏色或「安全好用」代替工作承諾。

sections.heading: 七、理解檢核：用一個新的產業情境練習
paragraphs: 某醫院開發了一套 AI 輔助檢查報告系統。
醫師可以上傳檢查資料，由 AI 產生報告草稿。醫院規定，AI 草稿必須經過合格醫師確認，才可以成為正式報告。
目前工程師提出這條驗收：

blocks.heading: 規格片段
paragraphs: 這段文字定義預期行為，尚未連到測試執行。
blocks.code:
Given AI 已產生檢查報告
When 使用者按下送出
Then 系統顯示成功

paragraphs: 寫程式是在告訴電腦怎麼做；寫驗收情境是在告訴所有參與者，什麼結果才算做對，以及什麼錯誤絕不能發生。
當這些條件寫清楚，無論採用哪種程式語言、框架，或更換哪個 AI Coding Agent，都能依據相同的外部行為要求來驗證成果。
這些 Scenario 是規格片段；若要建立可由 Cucumber 讀取的完整 `.feature` 檔，還需要 `Feature:` 標頭、步驟定義與測試執行環境。本頁的例子與醫院規則都是教學用合成情境，並未在真實銀行或醫院執行驗收。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器，沿用 problem.md 的合成案例。
steps: 建立 spec.md，寫四條 Given／When／Then，涵蓋完整、缺漏、空白及結果過期。
在每條情境旁列出輸入資料、預期提示及允許或禁止的動作。
和同儕交換規格，請他挑一條只靠文字重演；對有歧義的詞補上定義，記錄測試層次與待驗項。
exercise.expected: 至少四條可以重演的驗收情境，包含負向結果與對應證據欄位。
exercise.check: 同儕不需問你「正確是什麼」就能判斷結果；尚未執行的情境保持待驗證。
exercise.cleanup: 保留修訂紀錄；只用合成輸入，不填入真實帳號或業務資料。

readingGuide.goal: 區分前置條件、觸發動作與可觀察結果。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器，沿用 problem.md 的合成案例。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 至少四條可以重演的驗收情境，包含負向結果與對應證據欄位。

openChecks.prompt: 請為尚未經合格醫師核准的 AI 草稿，寫一條負向驗收的 Then。
answer: Then 系統應拒絕將草稿轉成正式報告，回應不得交付標記為正式的報告，並提示需由合格醫師確認。還需指定對應的測試、版本、執行命令與結果，才能判斷實作是否符合。

en.summary: Use Given/When/Then to express work commitments as observable scenarios, including negative cases for missing values, whitespace and input changes.
objectives: Distinguish preconditions, triggering actions and observable outcomes.
Write normal and negative acceptance scenarios for completeness checking.
Explain the links still needed between acceptance scenarios and executable tests.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish preconditions, triggering actions and observable outcomes.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor and the synthetic case in problem.md.
readingGuide.route: Read principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your understanding with checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: At least four replayable acceptance scenarios with negative outcomes and corresponding evidence fields.

sections.heading: How can we confirm that software meets its requirements?
paragraphs: This lesson belongs to Specification-Driven Development. It addresses a common software-development question:
Why can a system differ from what we wanted even after we tell an engineer or AI what to build?
One reason is that we describe a list of features without defining correct outcomes or the conditions that require rejection.
The goal is to turn ambiguous requirements into acceptance criteria that engineers, AI Coding Agents and testers can understand together and actually verify.

sections.heading: 1. Understand Given / When / Then
paragraphs: Imagine ordering at a restaurant.
You tell the server, “I would like a steak without onions.”
The steak arrives with onions. The server says, “But we did make the steak.”
The restaurant completed the feature of preparing steak, but failed to follow the conditions you requested.
Software development has the same problem.
“Build an ordering system” needs more detail: what outcome should a particular user action produce under specified conditions?
Given / When / Then expresses those conditions, actions and outcomes.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three positions in Given / When / Then
blocks.description: Arrows connect preconditions, the trigger and the expected outcome within one synthetic ordering scenario.

items.title: Given — preconditions | Before
items.body: The customer has selected steak but has not entered a delivery address.

items.title: When — trigger | During
items.body: The customer selects Confirm order.

items.title: Then — expected outcome | After
items.body: Display “Enter a delivery address,” create no official order and retain the selected food.

paragraphs: The three keywords ask three questions:

blocks.caption: Questions answered by each part
rows: Which conditions hold when the scenario begins?
What counts as success or correct rejection?

paragraphs: This description is common in Behavior-Driven Development (BDD). Gherkin is a structured syntax for describing behavioral scenarios; Cucumber is one tool that connects scenarios to automated test code.

sections.heading: 2. Why “the system works normally” is insufficient
paragraphs: Suppose you ask AI to build a bank-transfer system.
Your requirement is:
“Let customers transfer money, and keep the system secure.”
That sounds reasonable, but leaves outcomes undefined.
Does a screen displaying “Success” after pressing Transfer count as completion? What if no money is debited, money is debited twice, or a transfer proceeds despite insufficient funds?
Turn the requirement into rules that a reviewer can judge.
Consider a simplified demonstration transfer system:

blocks.heading: Specification fragment
paragraphs: This text defines expected behavior; it is not connected to test execution.
blocks.code:
Scenario: 餘額不足時不得轉帳

Given 我的帳戶有 1,000 元
When 我要求轉帳 1,500 元
Then 系統應拒絕這筆轉帳
And 顯示「餘額不足」
And 我的帳戶餘額仍為 1,000 元
And 收款人帳戶不得增加 1,500 元

paragraphs: `And` adds another condition that must hold at the same time. In the preserved scenario above, the account has 1,000 units of currency and requests a transfer of 1,500. The system must reject it, display “Insufficient funds,” retain the sender’s 1,000 balance and prevent a 1,500 credit to the recipient.
Even this simple request has four acceptance points: reject the transaction, explain why, prevent a debit and prevent a credit.
An acceptance scenario specifies both required outcomes and outcomes that must never occur.

sections.heading: 3. Positive and negative acceptance
paragraphs: Positive acceptance asks whether the system can complete the task when the conditions are valid.
Negative acceptance asks whether it safely rejects, blocks or handles a request when conditions are invalid, data is problematic or permissions are insufficient.

blocks.caption: Positive and negative acceptance in six industries
rows: Place an order when stock is sufficient
Do not promise shipment when stock is insufficient
Complete an authorized transfer with sufficient funds
Neither debit nor credit when funds are insufficient
Qualified staff can read authorized records
Unauthorized staff cannot obtain record content
Employees can view their own payslips
They cannot view other employees’ pay
Complete enrollment when prerequisites are met
Block protected operations beyond tool permissions

paragraphs: Negative acceptance checks that the system continues to follow its rules under invalid conditions.

blocks.heading: Displaying an error and actually blocking the action
paragraphs: Check authorization against the server response and content actually obtained.
Suppose a medical system prohibits general administrative staff from downloading complete patient records.
An administrator presses Download, and the screen displays:
“You do not have permission.”
If the API has already returned the file and the frontend merely hides the download button, the content is still exposed.
Verification must establish the following:

- The user did not obtain the file content.
- The server rejected the unauthorized request.
- Other interfaces cannot bypass the authorization check.
Observe both the result shown to the user and whether the protected action was actually blocked.

sections.heading: 4. Four acceptance scenarios for the teaching example
paragraphs: Use this lesson’s synthetic intake-checking example.
The form has three required fields: application number, applicant code and document type.
Four different scenarios cover the following conditions.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Four parallel acceptance scenarios
blocks.description: A–D test different conditions without a required order. Within D, changed data invalidates the old validation result.

items.title: Scenario A: complete data
items.body: All three fields have valid values. The user checks the form. Completeness passes, and preview and export use the same record.

items.title: Scenario B: a required field is missing
items.body: Document type is empty. Identify the omission, prevent export of a report marked complete and retain entered data.

items.title: Scenario C: whitespace-only input
items.body: Applicant code contains three spaces. It is not necessarily an empty string, but trimming leaves no valid content, so treat it as missing.

items.title: Scenario D: data changes after a pass
items.body: The user passes validation, then deletes document type. Invalidate the old result immediately and prevent export using the stale success state.

paragraphs: Scenario D checks that a validation result still corresponds to the current data version.
Imagine that a bank credit record passes validation at 10:00 a.m.; someone changes an important field at 10:05; another person prepares to export a report at 10:10.
A result from 10:00 may no longer apply.
Bind validation results to the data version that was checked and revalidate their applicability when exporting.
This illustrates Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU): a condition true when checked may no longer be true when used.

sections.heading: 5. Give acceptance scenarios to an AI Coding Agent
paragraphs: Acceptance scenarios directly support AI-assisted development.
An ambiguous instruction would be:
> Build a data-checking feature that lets users export reports.
The agent has substantial room to interpret the requirement.
Write the requirement and acceptance scenarios into `spec.md` first.

The simplified document below preserves the original Chinese specification. Its business rule requires non-whitespace values in all three required fields before a report can be marked complete and exported. A permits current-data export after a pass. B identifies missing document type, blocks complete export and retains other values. C treats a whitespace-only applicant code as missing and blocks a complete status. D starts with a pass followed by clearing document type: discard the old result, check current data and block complete export.

blocks.heading: Specification fragment
paragraphs: This text defines expected behavior; it is not connected to test execution.
blocks.code:
# 收件完整性檢核規格

## 業務規則
三個必要欄位都必須有非空白值，
才能將報告標記為完整並匯出。

## Scenario A：資料完整
Given 三個必要欄位皆有有效值
When 使用者要求檢查並匯出
Then 顯示完整性通過
And 允許匯出目前資料的報告

## Scenario B：資料缺漏
Given 文件類型為空
When 使用者要求匯出
Then 顯示文件類型缺漏
And 不得匯出完整報告
And 保留其他已填資料

## Scenario C：空白輸入
Given 申請人代號僅含空白字元
When 使用者按下檢查
Then 將此欄位視為缺漏
And 不得標記完整

## Scenario D：檢核結果過期
Given 先前的資料已通過檢核
And 使用者後來清空文件類型
When 使用者要求匯出
Then 原先的檢核結果不得繼續使用
And 必須檢查目前的資料
And 不得匯出完整報告

paragraphs: Then instruct the AI:
“Implement this feature according to `spec.md` and create matching tests for all four scenarios. Do not relax the required-field rules. Provide actual test results and the code diff when finished.”
`spec.md` provides a shared contract for the engineer and agent.

Writing Gherkin or Markdown scenarios does not execute tests. Cucumber automation also needs Step Definitions that connect natural-language steps to test code. The same acceptance requirements can also be implemented with pytest or interface tests.

blocks.heading: Update scenarios when requirements change
paragraphs: If a fourth required field is added, update the specification, normal and missing-field scenarios, form and test data together; have the domain owner confirm the new rule.

sections.heading: 6. Judge the quality of acceptance criteria
paragraphs: Use these questions to review each criterion.

blocks.caption: Six acceptance-quality checks
rows: Return rejection and create no order
Do not export a complete report
When user data has a problem
When document type is an empty string
Record the test name, result and version

paragraphs: Evidence fields let another person inspect execution.
Ten written scenarios establish what should be accepted; they do not establish that the system passed acceptance.
Connect these five layers:

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Trace requirements to inspectable evidence
blocks.description: Arrows indicate links that must be inspectable between adjacent layers. Drawing this chain does not establish execution or a pass.

items.title: Requirement
items.body: Define the work commitment and forbidden outcomes.

items.title: Acceptance Scenario
items.body: Express the requirement through concrete conditions, actions and outcomes.

items.title: Test Case
items.body: Specify operations and comparison with actual outcomes.

items.title: Test Result
items.body: Record the outcome actually observed in this run.

items.title: Evidence
items.body: Retain the tested version, command and result for independent inspection.

paragraphs: For example, if the specification prohibits exporting an incomplete report, the matching test must actually attempt export and confirm that no report marked complete was generated or delivered. Record the tested version, command and outcome; an AI statement that “tests passed” is insufficient evidence.
This gives reviewers evidence for whether observed behavior meets the requirement.

blocks.heading: Keep criteria observable and independent of appearance
paragraphs: Judge actions actually allowed or rejected; button position, color or “secure and usable” cannot replace the work commitment.

sections.heading: 7. Understanding check: a new industry scenario
paragraphs: A hospital is developing an AI-assisted examination-report system.
Physicians upload examination data and AI produces a draft. The hospital’s example rule requires a qualified physician to approve the draft before it becomes an official report.
An engineer proposes this acceptance scenario:

blocks.heading: Specification fragment
paragraphs: This text defines expected behavior; it is not connected to test execution.
blocks.code:
Given AI 已產生檢查報告
When 使用者按下送出
Then 系統顯示成功

paragraphs: Code tells the computer how to act. Acceptance scenarios tell everyone which outcomes count as correct and which errors must never occur.
Clear conditions allow the same external behavior requirements to guide verification across languages, frameworks and AI Coding Agents.

These Scenarios are specification fragments. A complete Cucumber `.feature` file also needs a `Feature:` header, step definitions and a test runtime. The examples and hospital rule are synthetic teaching scenarios, not acceptance tests executed at a real bank or hospital. The preserved three-line example says: Given AI has generated a report; When the user submits; Then display success. It omits the required approval condition.

exercise.environment: A text editor and the synthetic case in problem.md.
steps: Create spec.md with four Given/When/Then scenarios covering complete data, missing input, whitespace and stale results.
For each, list inputs, expected feedback and allowed or forbidden actions.
Exchange specifications with a peer and have them replay one from text alone. Define ambiguous terms and record test layers and pending items.
exercise.expected: At least four replayable acceptance scenarios with negative outcomes and corresponding evidence fields.
exercise.check: A peer can judge outcomes without asking what “correct” means. Unexecuted scenarios remain pending verification.
exercise.cleanup: Retain revision history. Use synthetic inputs, not actual accounts or business data.

openChecks.prompt: Write a negative-acceptance Then for an AI draft not approved by a qualified physician.
answer: Then reject conversion of the draft to an official report, return no report marked official and explain that a qualified physician must approve it. Identify the matching test, version, execution command and outcome before judging implementation compliance.

en.prompt: What is the most serious defect in the hospital scenario’s Given / When / Then?
options: It does not confirm approval of the official report by a qualified physician.
It does not specify the button color.
It does not specify which language model the AI must use.
It does not require PDF output.
rationales: The example requires qualified-physician approval before a report becomes official. The scenario checks neither this condition nor forbidden behavior without approval.
Button color does not establish that approval rules are enforced.
Choosing a model cannot replace qualified-physician approval.
A file format does not establish authorization for official release.
